extracted.name: How to Make Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: If you need a fresh, crowd-pleasing side dish that practically makes itself, this Cucumber Onion Salad is the answer. Thinly sliced cucumbers and sweet onion marinate in a simple tangy dressing, creating a crisp, refreshing salad that pairs perfectly with grilled meats all summer long.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 or a large sweet onion (, or red onion )
salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Slice cucumbers into thin slices. Slice the wedge of sweet onion into very thin slices. Place veggies in a large bowl.
Marinade: In a small bowl combine the vinegar, sugar, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper. Taste the dressing--it's easy to adapt it if you want it to be a little sweeter or more tangy.
Pour dressing over veggies and toss to combine. For best results, allow the mixture to marinate for at least an hour before serving.
